name: Alex Finn
text:
If you use AI, you need to switch to Omarchy immediately

It is an AI first, open source operating system by @dhh and it has skyrocketed my productivity

In this video I cover how to use it, how to install it, and why I'm having more fun using computers than I ever have before:

name: Ojisan Kaichou
text:
After 3 days I am confident in saying that Omarchy Quattro is the absolute best operating system I have ever used, hands down. Better than MacOS. Better than Ubuntu. Way better than Windows. 

I never knew how much I wanted a tiling window manager until now. I never knew how slow everything else is until now. I didn't know that computing could be as easy and enjoyable today as it was back in the Commodore 64 era. 

It strikes the perfect balance between "it just works" and "it works if you put in the effort." MacOS is the former, other Linux distros are the latter. The AI integration with Omarchy makes it easy to customize and fix any problems along the way with minimum friction and frustration. Doing everything with keyboard commands takes me back to the Windows 3 era when Windows was fun and not an evil overlord.

But I do know that I have only scratched the surface of what Omarchy has to offer. The future looks bright!

name: Lars Jansen
text:
I finally looked into Omarchy and I can see why dev twitter is suddenly obsessed with it.

It’s basically Arch with somebody else making all the hard/endless decisions for you.

Hyprland. Terminal first. Keyboard driven. Neovim. Plain config files. Very little “click through six settings panels and hope for the best”

This style of OS makes a lot of sense now with ai. An agent can read the config, edit the config, install the package , restart he service, inspect the logs and change the workflow.

Which is weird because the future of ai computing might end up looking a lot like the old way of using computers: files, terminals, scripts, text and a machine you can actually understand.

name: Alex Finn
text:
I'm officially Linux pilled

Over the weekend I installed Omarchy on my old gaming computer

Since then I've absolutely fallen in love with using computers again

Rough notes on why using it is so great, and why I think you need to give it a try:

• SUPER performant. Runs incredibly well on an old Dell Alienware computer from years ago that was just sitting in my closet collecting dust

• No floating windows just makes sense. By default, all windows in Omarchy auto tile rather than float. Every time you open an app, it splits the screen further automatically. I find it impossible to go back to floating windows on Mac now. Feels archaic and sluggish to manage

• No bloatware. Windows for me has become completely unusable the last few years. Copilot, ads, and all the extras that manufacturers include with it has made it the most unpleasant experience in computers. Omarchy comes with none of that.

• Feels built for AI. Basically every harness including Codex and Grok Bot have native apps for Omarchy.

• Built for productivity. Switching workspaces and using the keyboard for basically everything just feels snappy and quick

• Makes computing fun again. Something about the whole experience is just FUN. Learning all the new key bindings, making my set up personal and my own. I got home every night this weekend just looking forward to getting back to my computer.

HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend trying Omarchy out for yourself.

You don't need to buy a new computer for this. It can run on really old hardware. Just grab a laptop or desktop from your closet and set it up. Ask your agent how to flash a thumb drive so you can install it.

Codex basically did the entire setup and installation for me

The learning curve is really small. As long as you have an agent up and ask it questions any time you're confused, it should be able to help you out.

And if you install tailscale and connect it to your private network, your agents can even control it from other computers.

Altho it's not necessary, I'm going to pick up a Framework laptop to use this. Need to take this on the go.

Excellent work @dhh

name: Dmitrii Kovanikov
text:
Just finished @lexfridman interview with @DHH. Absolute hopecore. Truly a cure for AI psychosis.

I'm excited about how a single person can actually compete with Apple, Google and Microsoft in the OS space with the help of agents. AI is an incredible amplifier. And I actually love the idea. I don't want to live in this Cyberpunk 2077 world where we only have these 5 corporations that exist forever, and that's it.

Even if I don't agree with DHH on everything (although I still agree on many things), he's the person I can easily listen to for 5 hours.

I just have to install Omarchy after this, don't I? You'll never guess which feature finally motivated me to get over the struggle of *checks notes* a 1-minute installation.
